title: Five Reasons to Plant Corn at Two Inches Deep
reason: The transcript describes the importance of planting corn at the right depth and provides multiple reasons for this.

tasks.task: Explain the importance of planting corn at two inches deep.

subtasks.text: Demonstrate how the cornfield is planted almost perfectly at two inches deep.
Highlight that the nodal root system is consistently about three-quarters of an inch below the soil line.
List the first reason for planting two inches deep: it ensures uniform germination.
Mention the second reason: it ensures uniform emergence.
Explain the third reason: it provides consistent soil temperature and moisture.
Describe the fourth reason: the planter's closing wheels firm up the seed bed at this depth.
State the fifth reason: it reduces the seed's exposure to pre-emergence chemicals.
